properties.description: Monetary adjustment amount applied to the claim-invoice pairing. Observed values include zero (no adjustment, e.g. 0), fractional decimals (e.g. 25.98, 13.5), and large whole numbers (e.g. 6000, 9000). Must be stored as DECIMAL, not FLOAT, to avoid rounding errors in financial calculations.
properties.name: amount

properties.description: Numeric foreign key referencing the parent claim record (e.g. 3764, 3770, 3821). Links this adjustment entry back to its originating claim and is expected to join to a claims master table on its primary key.
properties.name: claim_id

properties.description: Composite surrogate primary key. Format: SVIC<timestamp/sequence>#<invoice_id>, where the segments after the first '#' replicate the row's full invoice_id (number, customer/vendor code, and two trailing numeric codes). Embeds invoice identity plus a creation timestamp/sequence. Not a clean UUID — do not use as a join key to other tables.
properties.name: id

properties.description: Composite invoice identifier using '#' as a delimiter, encoding four segments: invoice number, customer/vendor code, and two trailing numeric tenant/client codes (e.g. SVINV56118871#20082025#527#1031, SVINV17076499#Blue Prism#530#1034). The invoice-number prefix is inconsistent (INV / SVIN / SVINV / SVINO), the second segment may be a date, a customer code, or a free-text vendor name (which can contain spaces), and the value is replicated inside id. Requires string parsing to extract components for joins.
properties.name: invoice_id
